source.printedToPdfMapping: Printed page N maps to PDF page N+1 for mapped printed pages 1-128. PDF page 1 is front cover; PDF page 130 is back cover. PDF page 129 maps to printed page 128 advertising/end matter.

method.render: PyMuPDF rendered all 130 PDF pages at 1.5x to private PNGs; private contact sheets show 8 pages each. Full pages were opened with view_image for PDF pages 4-6, 19-34, 36-43, 105-108, 118-119.
method.pixelReview: Contact-sheet screen on every physical page; full-page source pixels used to identify TOC/table headings and per-class feature/table boundaries on selected spans. Full-page views establish labels/layout only unless a narrower review is stated.
method.sourceFirst: Section/table inventory began from visually inspected printed TOC and table index, then was joined to the current assembled site catalog/code. Catalog page matches and OCR were candidates/mapping aids, not source passes.
method.semanticReview: No whole-book semantic review, comprehensive value transcription, complete marker census, or source-to-data row reconciliation was performed as part of this inventory. Source-unit count for prose ability/rule clauses remains unknown.
method.privacy: Full PDF renders and contact sheets remain in the private audit workspace; none are included or referenced as public image assets.
priorWorkNotDuplicated: 206 XP target tuples plus 10 Cavalier HP target reviews; no numeric/source-value grades promoted. Three PHB physical XP rows remain outside the earlier XP tuple denominator.
